typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	tblSLACPcontraparties_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		legalFullName as string,
		emailAddress2 as string,
		testEmailAddress2 as string,
		contraParty as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		legalFullName as string,
		emailAddress2 as string,
		testEmailAddress2 as string,
		contraParty as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		legalFullName,
		emailAddress2,
		testEmailAddress2,
		contraParty),
	partitionFileNames:[($tblSLACPcontraparties_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> tblSLACPcontraparties
